concurrencyDurabilityAudit.deadLockRecoveryBehavior: Expired locks with dead PIDs on host are safely unlinked and reclaimed without manual intervention.
concurrencyDurabilityAudit.monotonicRevocationBehavior: Once an approvalId is revoked, subsequent writes with unrevoked status remain revoked in the durable ledger.
concurrencyDurabilityAudit.conflictDetectionBehavior: Attempting to persist an existing approvalId with a different canonical payload digest triggers CONFLICT_ERROR.
concurrencyDurabilityAudit.idempotentDuplicateHandling: Identical payloads on the same approvalId return IDEMPOTENT_SKIP with success true.
concurrencyDurabilityAudit.safeFallbackOnCorruptLedger: Malformed ledger JSON returns null gracefully without uncaught exceptions or process crash.
